# Home-network rule for plain http:// (BMD-N10, code review BMD-R8). One case per line: "allow HOST" or "block HOST".
# HOST is written as in a URL (IPv6 in brackets). Used by both implementations of the rule:
#   tests/test_rules_and_export_safety.js   isPlainHttpAllowed in app/static/strato_app.js
#   android/app/src/test/.../LocalNetworkTest.java   LocalNetwork.isPlainHttpAllowed in the Android app
# Change the rule in both places and add the case here.

# this device
allow localhost
allow LOCALHOST
allow ollama.localhost
allow 127.0.0.1
allow 127.255.255.254
allow [::1]

# home network names
allow studio.local
allow nas.lan
allow box.home.arpa
allow gpu.tailnet-1234.ts.net

# private IPv4 ranges, link-local, CGNAT (Tailscale)
allow 10.0.0.1
allow 10.255.255.255
allow 192.168.1.5
allow 172.16.0.1
allow 172.31.255.255
allow 169.254.10.20
allow 100.64.0.1
allow 100.127.255.255

# IPv6 link-local and unique local
allow [fe80::1]
allow [fd12:3456::1]
allow [fc00::1]

# internet
block example.com
block api.openai.com
block 8.8.8.8
block 1.1.1.1
block 172.15.0.1
block 172.32.0.1
block 192.169.0.1
block 100.63.255.255
block 100.128.0.1
block 169.253.0.1
block 11.0.0.1
block [2001:4860:4860::8888]
block [fe8::1]

# look-alikes
block fdomain.com
block local
block evil-local.com
block localhost.example.com
block mylan
block ts.net.example.com
